notes.title: The second update in the game.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34256302/e76bb70bd67729ed2b36a4f98744baa377e9e625.gif[/img]

Thanks to everyone who played and posted the video on Youtube, we studied your impressions of the game and made this update. 
And everyone who wrote us reviews about the game, we listened to you and are working on improvements! 

So, the list of changes and additions in the game: 

• Dynamic chest with physics. 
• The menu added a lot of interesting details. 
• Added the sound of box breaks. 
• Removed neck twisting in girls. 
• When the monster mode is activated, girls who wash begin to wave their hands. 
• Changed the balance in the game. Now, the more bras you have, the faster the bonus will accumulate! 
• Now, if you do not have enough time for a bra, then you will take away the accumulated white energy! 
• A clock marked with was added to the game at the top of the radio. The clock is animated. 
• Now that the time exceeds 10 minutes, the girls stop appearing and the police are after you! 
• Added a small explanation of the elements of the interface. 
• Added an increase in icons when lifting items. 
• When the bonus is over, a clock with exclamation marks will appear on the screen! 
• Where there is no water in the shower, there will be signs that the shower is not working. 
• The girls appeared aggression! If they see you, then aggression will accumulate, and then it will overwhelm you! They do not see you behind your back! if you do not look at the girl and she saw you, it will not accumulate aggression. 
• If you throw objects at girls, then they activate aggression! 
• A beach ball has been added to the game, you can hit it! 
• Achievements have been added, now they are working in test mode! 
• Changed the cover in the store. 

Our plans for the future: 
- Improve AI. 
- Finish the animation. 
- Complete points balance. 
- Make the game more interesting and dynamic! 
- Make a new beautiful graphics! 
- Make a new trailer. 

Thanks to everyone who bought the game on release! You inspired us to improve the game! We hope that you will appreciate our game, since we are listening to your game or not completing the game!

notes.title: The first update after the release of the game.
notes.content:
Hi, and thank you for buying our games, thanks to you the game gets the first updates. 
 
And so we changed or added to the game for this period of time: 
 
- A new menu in which graphics settings, sound settings and language selection appeared. 
- New font in two languages. 
- When you first start the game you have to go through the tutorial to start the game. 
- Changed the sounds when raising bonuses. 
- In the game you can now set the sensor FPS. 
- Added animation for washable girls. 
- When you start the game, the player no longer look at the wall. 
- If you took the bra, now they can not be thrown, they will be with you until the timer ends with them. 
- The bra accumulates the energy of bras and if the timer runs out, the energy will not be reset. 
- If you have one bra, then energy will accumulate for a long time, the bigger the bra. 
 
They write us about disabling censorship. We will try to turn it off in the next update! 
But for now, use this method to turn off pixels https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1640003567. We do not know how he did it, but he has a talent in programming, we will definitely contact him to cooperate!
